resources.string: The app checks for updates when you open the library. You choose when to download and install; Android will ask for confirmation.
Choose check to find the latest VLCPlayer release.
Read the changes below, then choose download. You can watch videos while it downloads.
The download continues when you leave this screen. Return here to see progress and install.
Checking the file and whether it can update the app.
The file has been checked. Install when convenient; you do not need to download it again.
Allow VLCPlayer to install apps in Android settings. When you return, the app will continue with the downloaded file.
Confirm in the Android installer. The app may close when the update succeeds.
There is no newer release for this app.
VLCPlayer has been updated. The installer file is removed after the new version is confirmed.
This release has no description of its changes.
A new VLCPlayer release is available
Version %1$s is ready. Open updates to read the changes and choose when to download or install.
An update is ready. Open VLCPlayer to continue.
Could not check for updates. Check your internet connection and try again.
Release information is incomplete or invalid. Try checking again later.
The download did not complete. Check your connection and retry.
Not enough storage or the file could not be written. Free up storage and try again.
The update file was not found. Download it again.
The download is damaged or does not match the release. Download it again.
This file is not a VLCPlayer update. Check the release again.
The file version does not match the release information or is not newer than the installed version.
The update signature is not compatible with the installed app. This release cannot be installed.
The update is not compatible with this device or Android version.
Installation could not complete. You can retry using the downloaded file.
You canceled installation. The file remains ready to install when convenient.
Android or device policy is blocking installation. Check installation permission and try again.
Android could not update because of a conflict with the installed app.
